protocol.train: 40000 gateway TRAIN plus all 150000 original kp-280m RO/EN/PL general rows; CC-BY-4.0; manifest pins local bytes and source URLs
protocol.selection: minimum gateway DEV token loss at each 1000-step checkpoint; no test selection; report all independently trained seeds
protocol.seeds: 0 first; 1 and 2 only if each completed training run takes under 10800 seconds; XLM-R optional
protocol.gateway_operator: KP simple aggregation, 512-token overflow stride64, native offsets, literal block-mask union; same protected-character coverage as RES-126 deletion. Presidio stock English threshold0. Shield pinned native DEFAULT replace.
protocol.anchor_operator: Frozen RES-125 operators including KP 512-token cap/stride0; reuse matched baseline receipts, rescore with RES-126 harness. Full gold remains in denominator. Anchor truncation is a limitation, never a service claim.
protocol.win: Each of at least 3 training seeds: candidate Wilson upper below comparator lower AND paired leak delta upper<0 AND over-redaction delta upper<=0; no new legacy national-ID leaks; every language plus reviewed/disjoint gold required. Any missing gate is unverified.
limits: Synthetic gateway gold lacks independent native review
Legacy semantic training disjointness remains unverified
protocol.throughput_amendment: Initial seed0 padding probe stopped before first dev evaluation/checkpoint; length grouping enabled before completed training or test scoring. Same rows, seed and batch16. Probe retained in scratch.
protocol.f1_amendment: Before candidate test scoring, first Presidio gateway scoring failed: char-disjoint gold entities share whitespace tokens. Full gateway BIOES F1 unavailable. Report harness F1 conditional on gold-representable conversations, with n/exclusion census. No conversation excluded from primary residual v2 or utility. No acceptance uses conditional F1.

training_amendments.reason: The unbucketed seed0 memory sample reported 45.4 GiB resident and32.6 GiB swapped near step2200 (48.6 GiB physical footprint). Shape caching was the initial hypothesis; a brief pause of our CPU baselines did not resolve it. Later external CPU calibration was observed. No isolated causal or throughput claim is established.
training_amendments.change: Round collator padding to a multiple of32, limiting tensor lengths to16 possible shapes, while preserving batch16, fp32, max_length512 and all rows. Restart seed0 from the same initialization; no partial probe selected by test results.
training_amendments.evidence: Assigned scratch/training-memory.txt and runs/mdeberta-280m-seed0-shape-probe; both early throughput probes retained for audit.
training_amendments.selection: Unchanged: gateway-dev loss at1000-step checkpoints only. No candidate test scores inspected. All completed seed runs use the amended recipe.
training_amendments.prediction_protocol: Unchanged; existing baseline prediction identities remain pinned to res127-protocol.json. These amendments affect training execution only.
training_amendments.allocator_amendment: Rounded padding reduced allocation but did not prevent another slowdown. Enable the installed Trainer torch_empty_cache_steps=25 and resume checkpoint2000 with optimizer/RNG state. Preserve previous pin and elapsed session time in resume-history.json. No candidate test scoring occurred.
training_amendments.host_queue: Five independent RES-100 CPU calibration processes were subsequently observed. The memory-heavy MPS run was queued without touching another task's processes. The under3h additional-seed rule uses the retained training run's elapsed wall time, including resumes and its host queue. Two earlier abandoned probes contributed no weights to this run; their overhead is recorded separately in timing.json.
training_amendments.activation_checkpointing: Enable the installed DeBERTa/Trainer non-reentrant activation checkpointing to reduce live intermediate memory and resume checkpoint2000. Preserve batch16, fp32, max_length512, all training rows, optimizer and RNG state. Record this execution-profile change in the training pin; verify actual memory and progress before continuing.

resume_history.reason: Enable cache clearing every25 steps; preserve optimization/data/seed settings
Queue for external RES100 CPU calibration; no further100-step progress saved after resume
Queued profile updated to activation checkpointing before restarting; no added active runtime

timing_basis.basis: start of retained pad32 seed0 run; includes its resumes and queue; earlier abandoned probes carried no weights into this run

mdeberta-280m.selection: minimum gateway-dev token loss; never test
limitations: Training truncates at 512; evaluation uses full-input overflow windows
TRAIN export joins parts with two newlines; harness dev/test uses one

contract_verdicts: Harness exact-character coverage; identifier subjects, not empirical attacker re-identification
Raw native offsets, operator receipts and ordered gold hashes in scratch
§2 deployed operator parity and replacement-content attestation
Pinned local operator experiment; replacement fragment-copy audit and deployed parity not established
Every observed new decode-bearing national-ID leak fails; see anchor table
3 completed candidate seeds; each gateway seed/language/comparator must pass separately
2000 paired resamples, RNG125; gateway delta upper<0 required; all deltas in JSON
Gateway non-PII non-whitespace character delta upper<=0, plus preserved legacy RO/PL zero floors
Numeric gateway gates only; reviewed/disjoint gold is the separate gate below; no pooled acceptance
Native review and legacy semantic disjointness remain open
No open-loop three-by-ten-minute trials, frozen <=256-token replay, or 16 offered req/s load point
§4 p95 point and bootstrap upper <=250 ms
No end-to-end HTTP latency trials; training/inference runtime is not serving latency
§4 successful completed throughput >=15 req/s in every trial
No gateway deadline or cancellation trials
Gateway evaluation uses full-input overflow; anchors retain 512-token cap; deployment untested
§4 long-input lane, admission and mixed-traffic interference
No separate 257-2048-token SLO or unsupported-payload refusal/load trials
Integration, rollback, pseudonym maps and semantic utility
